newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Hoogovens, Boel partners in Boel recapitalisation.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens, Boel partners in Boel recapitalisation.

text.p: Dutch metals group Koninklijke Hoogovens and steel maker Usines Gustave Boel of Belgium said on Tuesday they had agreed to work on the formation of a 50/50 partnership for the recapitalisation of Boel.
The partnership would encompass the industrial activities of Boel, the companies said in a joint statement.
Boel said in the wake of a study of its position in the steel market that cooperating with a major player such as Hoogovens would create new opportunities.
It noted it was Hoogovens' strategy to strengthen its position in the markets where the Dutch company was present.
To return Boel to profitability its current activities in Belgium and France would be restructured and strengthened.
The companies said the transaction would be completed by the end of the year after further investigation and a due diligence procedure.
